name: Brief the next meeting
description: Check the calendar for meetings starting inside the lead time and send a brief for any that has not had one. Follow the stored procedures 'Which meetings get a brief' — applied first — and 'How to write a meeting brief'. Read the installation settings included with this run and honour 'lead_minutes', 'skip_recurring' and 'focus'. Use the brief_window function for the send time and the history window to search.
response_policy: Each brief is one chat message; back-to-backs share one message before the first, and no meeting is briefed twice.
